DESIGN: Removing age transitions entirely, or adding a classic mode, would make the reviewer switch to a positive rating.
The game feels like a major regression from earlier Civ entries, and the execution seems poor compared to Humankind.
CONTENT: A major step backward: an unfinished product whose three-stage age system punishes players who play well.
Needs many updates across the board and feels like an early access release rather than a finished game.
UI: A scam, with uncontrollable behavior, English input defaulting, and map scrolling during hands-off play; the reviewer calls it garbage.
STAB: Not polished; disappointing given the studio's track record, with auto-generated maps, weak diplomacy, poor UI info, and messy age transitions.
Very poorly optimized: repeated crashes on a high-end PC made the game unplayable, so the reviewer got a refund.
